in_marathi.name: Bhukya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhukya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Bhukya is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Bhuk’ which means ‘food’ or ‘sustenance’. It is a name given to a baby girl in Hindu culture, symbolizing the divine blessings of abundance and nourishment.
